patterns.note: Full-bleed editorial imagery and video are used as primary visual elements, often serving as backgrounds for text overlays, creating an immersive and high-fashion aesthetic.

Consistent use of a single, clean sans-serif typeface across all text, with variations primarily in size and weight, and frequent use of uppercase for headings and labels, reinforcing a minimal and bold brand identity.
A high-contrast monochrome palette of black and white, with subtle light grey backgrounds for content sections, creating a stark, sophisticated, and uncluttered visual experience.
A transforming sticky header that changes from transparent to a solid white background, with black text, and slightly reduces in height as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Scroll-triggered reveals for content sections, where elements subtly fade in or slide up as they enter the viewport, enhancing content discovery and providing a dynamic loading experience.

Product grids are presented in varying column counts (e.g., 2, 3, 4 columns) to accommodate different product types and visual emphasis, breaking the monotony of a single grid structure and allowing for diverse product presentation.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-width, auto-playing video as the hero background, with text and call-to-action buttons overlaid, creating an immersive initial experience that sets an editorial tone.

A sticky navigation bar is implemented that transitions from a transparent state over the hero to a solid white background with black text and a slightly reduced height once the user scrolls past the hero section, maintaining brand presence.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely using a library like locomotive-scroll, are used to reveal content sections with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, providing a dynamic and engaging content loading experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Balanced sans-serif headings (~2-3x body) with small, clear uppercase labels, maintaining a sophisticated and readable hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with almost all elements (images, buttons, containers) featuring 0px corner radii, contributing to a modern and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, characterized by significant vertical whitespace between sections and around content blocks, creating a premium, uncluttered, and spacious feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-bleed, high-production-value video hero that seamlessly integrates with the brand's editorial content is highly impactful. This, combined with a stark, high-contrast black-and-white aesthetic and subtle scroll-triggered motion, creates an exceptionally luxe and immersive brand experience that feels more like a digital magazine than a typical e-commerce site.
